minutes_text:
AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  April 11, 2012
  7:00 P.M.

NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the
Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to
5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City
Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626)
812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at
213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California

Call To Order

Chairperson Kindred called the meeting to order at 7:18 p.m.

Pledge of Allegiance

Commissioner Donnelson led the flag salute.

Roll Call

Members present:  AVILA, LEE, KINDRED, MILLNER, DONNELSON
Members Absent:

Staff Present

Assistant Economic and Community Development, Conal McNamara; BBK Attorney, Mal Richardson;
Rosedale Project Planner, Roy Bruckner and Planning Assistant Kim Cooke.

Approval of Minutes

None

Public Participation

Mike Lee and Art Morales spoke.
 PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES -draft
April 11, 2012
Page 2 of 2

Public Hearings

  1.  Design Review No. DR-2011-17
  Location:  8625-001-043/044 & 045, 8625-002-004/28 & 029 (Rosedale)
  Applicant:  Christopher Development Group

Request for approval of a Design Review application to permit the construction of 68 new single family
homes distributed among Tracts 54057-7, 54057-10, & 54057-16 located within the Rosedale Planned
Community.

Mr. Bruckner gave the staff presentation before the Planning Commission and answered questions.

Mr. Holman, applicant’s representative, was present and answered questions of the Planning
Commission.

Commissioner Lee made a motion to adopt resolution to approve Design Review No. DR-2012-17 with an
additional Condition of Approval stating the front yard and parkway landscaping must be installed by
the home builder. Chairperson Kindred seconded the motion.

The vote was 5-0. The public was advised of the 20 day appeal period.

Unfinished Business

None

New Business

None

Reports and Communications

1.  CEQA (California Environmental Quality Act) Training.
Mr. Richardson, BBK attorney, gave a power point presentation to the Planning Commission.

2.  Staff update from the City Council meeting.
Mr. McNamara indicated Rosedale development as achieving success; Gold Line presentation in near
future and his gave report the Planning Commission.

Discussion Items from the Planning Commission

Chair Kindred asked for status on an approved project and staff answered questions.

Adjournment

The Commission voted unanimously to adjourn at 9:26 p.m.
The next regularly scheduled Planning Commission meeting is April 25, 2012.
